name: omaPGP
author: Yaël
description: Read, write, encrypt, decrypt, sign, and verify PGP text from the Omarchy bar using your local GnuPG keyring and bounded, pipe-only processing.

barWidget.description: Encrypt, decrypt, sign, and verify PGP text with your local GnuPG keys.

schema.label: GnuPG home folder
schema.description: Leave blank to use your normal keyring (~/.gnupg). Set an absolute folder, such as ~/.local/share/omapgp/gnupg, to keep a separate keyring just for omaPGP. Relative paths are refused.

schema.label: Clear copied plaintext after (seconds)
schema.description: After you copy a decrypted message, the clipboard is cleared after this many seconds if it still holds that text. Set 0 to never clear.
